title: STD-01 artifact framework (recipes, lifecycle, manifests, renditions, study state)
commit_message: feat(studio): STD-01 artifact framework (ARCH-13-001..014, TECH-13-001, ARCH-14-001)
implemented: domain artifacts.py: ArtifactType (10), ArtifactStatus (7-state lifecycle incl. out_of_date), transition table + assert_transition_allowed, ArtifactRequest.manifest_items(), FrozenInputs, Rendition, ArtifactRecipe protocol, payload schema v2 + v1 upcaster
application artifact_core.py: errors, views (Artifact/ArtifactVersion/UserArtifactState/StudySnapshot), ArtifactStore port (12 methods, CAS-only)
application artifact_recipes.py: typed RecipeRegistry + ONE deterministic composite_echo demo recipe (no model calls); empty-inputs rejected

application artifact_lifecycle.py: CreateArtifact, synchronous generate pipeline (CAS draft->generating, freeze manifest, CAS ->validating, plan/generate/validate, render, publish immutable version, CAS ->ready with current_version_id), EditArtifact (etag If-Match -> 409, new manifest child of base manifest), RegenerateArtifact (pinned base version), CancelArtifact, MarkOutOfDate; validation/CAS failure -> failed with prior versions untouched

application artifact_export.py: two-stage export - request revalidates authz + effective restrictions and issues a grant; download revalidates CURRENT restrictions (tightened -> denied); ExportDeniedError carries the policy reason
application artifact_study.py: UpdateStudyState (per-user, revision CAS), GetStudyState, SnapshotStudySession (private, never creates/mutates versions)
adapters artifact_store.py: PgArtifactStore (CAS, versions insert-only, optimistic user state, private snapshots, manifest round-trip)
adapters artifact_export.py: PgExportAuthorizer - notebook membership via NotebookReader, policy engine decide_notebook(READ_CONTENT), source_restrictions access_denied check (global or per-user)

api artifact_routes.py: 13 endpoints under /api/v1/artifacts (create/GET/generate/cancel/out-of-date/GET version/edit/regenerate/export request/export download/study state GET+PUT/snapshot); principal + authorize_notebook on every route; audit records with actor/request context; download route re-derives frozen source ids from the stored version row (client echo never trusted)

capability artifact_lifecycle registered: implemented=true, enabled=false in capabilities.yaml AND capabilities.generated.json (lockstep), conformance.json regenerated; NOT advertised until E2E-003/T35 enablement

migration 0009_std_01 (down_revision 0008_rsr_01b): additive widen of ck_artifacts_status to the full 7-state lifecycle; studio.py metadata updated to final shape; rehearse.py record_head/version_at_head now use current_script_head()

tests: full transition matrix (49 pairs), upcaster golden v1->v2 + idempotence + unknown rejection, lifecycle over fake store (edit lineage, prior-version retention, racing CAS -> failed), export double-revalidation with a flipping authorizer, study isolation + revision CAS + snapshot privacy, recipe registry/determinism/tamper-detection, live-PG store tests (CAS, insert-only versions, optimistic state, provenance)

notes: Production bug found+fixed: _GenerationPipeline._publish built the ArtifactVersionView but never called store.create_version - the immutable row was never persisted. Fixed; caught by the fake-store test asserting exactly one published version.

Pre-existing stale rehearsal fixture fixed (not caused by 0009): rehearse.py's immutability spot-check INSERT omitted canonical_documents columns parser_identity/parser_profile/tool_versions/contract_json (NOT NULL since 0002_ing_01b). Aligned the fixture with the current schema; rehearsal now runs the full destructive cycle green.

Runtime deviation (scratch-only, never committed): the t13-smoke cluster runs host PostgreSQL 17, which lacks PG18's built-in uuidv7(); the rehearsal DB was given the same public.uuidv7() SQL shim already present in the live t13 DB (48-bit unix-ms | version 7 | variant 10 | rand, per task-4 precedent).

Capability state: artifact_lifecycle implemented=true, enabled=false - effective surface unchanged (never advertised). Enabling later requires adding cap.artifact_lifecycle to MILPBOOKLM_ENABLED_CAPABILITY_FLAGS in scratch/t20-gate/start-api.sh at the orchestrator's next restart (NOT done in this task).

Export security: the download endpoint re-derives the frozen source_version id set from the stored artifact_versions.evidence_dependencies and re-checks membership + restrictions fresh; client-echoed ids are validated for path match only, never trusted for authorization.
artifact_versions immutability is enforced by the generic milpbooklm_immutability_violation() trigger (rehearsal immutability_enforced step + live-PG test assert UPDATE blocked and row unchanged).
